_note: ILLUSTRATIVE DATA. Eighteen initiatives invented for the STRATA proof of concept. Money in SAR million. Rules are evaluated by the engine: 'strategic' failures make the initiative OUT, 'capital' or 'dependency' failures make it DEFERRED. Rule expressions use lever ids and engine outputs. Each initiative names the objectives it serves, the functional plan it feeds, two to four projects whose capex sums to the initiative capex, and what it needs to work. KPI entries that look like K1 reference the scorecard in objectives.json.
